reason: Internal: design bundle only, no code. Adds a divergence that Step 0 method structurally could not find, and narrows what that method establishes. Which eval clients bypass the gateway cache differs from production and a kwarg diff cannot see it, because it is a header: NO_CACHE_HEADERS is applied at three sites (the SDK gate arm, GateProbe, the judge) while build_live_runner and build_live_participation_runner pass no default_headers, so the gate and the judge are cache-bypassed and the reply subject is not. Two consequences. First, issue 186 and ADR 0011 absolute numbers are cache-bypassed readings, as ADR 0011 states itself; the header is on both its arms so the comparison holds but neither number describes production. Second, for a reply suite with five samples per case the effective n is unverifiable from the outputs alone, because a case returning zero of five or five of five is exactly the shape a cache produces and is indistinguishable from genuine determinism, while one varying case proves only that the cache is not total. The split was never chosen: the header sits on the three clients somebody happened to be holding when they hit a caching problem, and nothing relates that set to the set of clients that make repeated identical calls. Nothing audits it and the run logs carry no per-sample elapsed time, so it needs a re-run with timing on the case line. Found by the culture-tier session while checking its own arm. The consequence for this bundle is that its constructor-argument table is a floor on the divergence rather than a measurement of it, and the rebuild one Nora has to mean one client as well as one composition.
